IGFBP-3  ●    C-Reactive Protein / CRP  ●    Homocysteine  ●    d-ROMs + PAT test  ●      Normal Price  >126,290   Package Price  60,500        Why is Annual Health Check Up Essential for You?  Annual health check up plays a crucial role in maintaining your physical and mental well-being. Proactively identifying risk factors and screening for diseases in the early stage when you are still healthy allows you to make the right lifestyle choices. Collaborating with experienced and skilled doctors, you can receive personalized medical advice on implementing positive changes in your diet and exercise routine and ensuring adequate rest. Undergoing regular health check ups fosters a foundation for long-term well-being and vitality.  Your Guide to a smooth experience in undergoing Annual Health Check Up   Prepare for Your Visit: Refrain from eating or drinking for 8-12 hours before your appointment.  For women , it is advised to schedule your check up after your menstrual period ends, preferably after 7-10 days, to avoid any potential interference with certain tests.  Medications: Take your daily medications as usual, aside from diabetic medications.  Schedule Your Appointment: For your convenience, please make an appointment at least 24 hours in advance and bring all your medications on the day of your appointment.   For more information, please contact Executive Healthcare Center 11th Floor Vejthani Hospital.
